description: Generate a textured 3D mesh (GLB) from a text prompt or a reference image URL. In text mode an AI art-director first refines your prompt into an optimized single-subject spec for higher mesh quality. Renders inline in an interactive 3D viewer. Use this when you want a higher quality mesh from a rough prompt or reference image, with the prompt refined for you first.

idempotency_key.description: Optional: any string you choose (up to 200 characters) that names this one generation, such as a task id. Calling again with the same key within 24 hours returns the original job instead of starting a new one, so a retry after a timeout never generates twice. Use a new key for a new model.

image_url.description: Optional http(s) URL to a reference image to reconstruct directly.

prompt.description: Description of the single object to model.

name: mesh_forge
title: Generate a 3D mesh (art-directed)
